added_failure_note: The reviewed run is a read-only evidence node whose write paths hold no test file; its classification.json carries baseline_suite null and after_suite null, so there are no suite arms to diff and no added failure id exists.

findings.text: the stable-sample arm cannot fail: assigns() reads attribution["per_name"], which the instrument populates only for names in the leave set (run.py:318), so a name that stayed accepted is never a key and bad is always empty; the declared negative control is falsifiable only in its leave-set half.

"every one reading DD resolution version must be one exact published version" is a universal the instrument never measures: it counts failure events and refusal text as two independent tallies (run.py:270-275), and 3035 failures against 9106 text occurrences is consistent with the conjunction rather than evidence of it.

the sourceless section reports the drain's 9 and the live 10 and explains only the 9-to-10 step, leaving the done_when's stated "3 after the source-drop repair" unreconciled, so a reader cannot tell whether the earlier repair regressed or the two probes count different populations.

_drift_probe repeats the stored-snapshot-versus-terminal comparison owned by source_refresh.py's _RESOLVE_SOURCE_TERMINAL (:47-52) and _source_deltas (:168-242) instead of calling them, so a change to the steering fields would leave this instrument measuring a different delta than the writer it blames.

justifications.durability: negative-control.py:15 reads a["per_name"], which sib-docs-regression-diagnosis-run.py:318 populates only for leave-set names, so the stable-sample arm is vacuous and only the leave-set arm can redden.
justifications.evidence: attribution.json records 405 left / 400 reset / 508 resets and every count reconciles against the drain's own before.json and after.json, but the negative control's falsifying half cannot fail and the review_name "every one" universal is two independent tallies rather than a conjunction.
justifications.fit: both files follow the docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/ <node>.html plus <node>-run.py pattern of its siblings; the HTML lacks a trailing newline.
justifications.goal_fidelity: sib-docs-regression-diagnosis.html:62-81 names the drift refresh as the writer and source_refresh.py:325-328 as the mechanism, with the stranded-identity change and the vocabulary reconcile excluded by code site at html:49-61.
justifications.reuse: sib-docs-regression-diagnosis-run.py:189 re-implements the RENAMED_TO terminal resolution and snapshot comparison that source_refresh.py:47-52 (_RESOLVE_SOURCE_TERMINAL) and _source_deltas at source_refresh.py:168-242 already own.
justifications.scope_discipline: the commit touches only the two declared evidence paths, with no plan edit, no graph write and no sn run.
